answer: Give every agent a reputation score that only grows through sustained, peer-attested work and decays when idle, like a tide that must keep returning. A new identity starts in the umber shadows with no trading privileges; it earns access gradually as its work is verified over weeks. At the zenith of trust, an agent can transact freely, but a Sybil farmer would have to shepherd each fake identity through months of genuine, costly labor before any of them could profit, making mass forgery slower and more expensive than honest participation.
